spec_match.rationale: Fixed 2026-11-15: container-type is now the valid `inline-size` (computed value verified "inline-size", was "normal"), so the size branch fires; Rule B no longer tries to style the container itself (a container query styles only descendants) and the code sample teaches the correct grammar.

interactive.rationale: Slider, Off/On flag and drag-resize all drive the card; verified each state transition of the 2x2 matrix in a real browser.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card's promise (resizable card, custom-property flag, Rule C comma OR, live truth table) matches the page's structure.

edge_cases.rationale: Matrix cells and the live summary are derived from computed display of .card-body/.badge-* (observed styles), and a warning appears if container-type is not inline-size or Rule C disagrees with its inputs (pre-150 comma-list drop).

references.rationale: Fixed 2026-10-04 (weekly hardening): the page now links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6196591858941952, matching its feature index — restoring invariant 3 and the fix-slugs self-heal. Verified by grep against the canonical id on the feature index.

conformance.rationale: The shared suite proves real parse/CSSOM contracts and honestly fails 4 of 5 in this pre-150 browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, unavailable in this cloud session) against a local server, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: slider 500/200, flag On/Off, programmatic drag-resize to 450px (ResizeObserver path) — matrix tracked getComputedStyle each time; zero console errors, no failed requests. Not chrome-devtools-mcp.

telemetry_health.rationale: Baseline injected telemetry only; no interaction/assert events, so the broken size branch would never surface in telemetry.

design_system.rationale: Raw `green` in the code sample replaced with var(--accent-emerald); new status/warn panels use tokens only.

accessibility.rationale: Off/On toggles expose aria-pressed in a labelled group, slider has a real name, and a polite role=status summary announces which rules fire.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360px (truth table now in its own scroller), but at 360px the container cannot exceed ~248px content width so the >320px size branch is not reachable on narrow phones — only the style branch can be demonstrated there.

openQuestions.title: Make the size branch reachable at phone widths
openQuestions.detail: At a 360px viewport the resizable container tops out at ~248px content width, so `(width > 320px)` can never match on narrow phones and the 'wide' cells are unreachable. Consider a lower threshold or a horizontally scrollable stage so both axes are demonstrable on mobile.

summary: Weekly hardening 2026-11-15: fixed invalid `container-type: inline-size style` (size branch was dead everywhere; computed container-type was "normal"), moved the Rule B highlight onto a descendant, derived the matrix from observed computed styles via ResizeObserver (drag-resize now tracked), added aria-pressed + polite live summary and a disagreement warning. Verified in headless Chromium 153 desktop+mobile with zero console errors.

guidanceConsulted.query: external reference links list rel noopener semantics
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep target=_blank external links on rel=noopener; no further guidance matched a plain reference-list addition.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the restored ChromeStatus links use target=_blank rel=noopener in the page's existing see-also list pattern; change is a reference-list fix only, no layout/control/CSS behavior touched.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Do not set container-type for style queries (every element is a style container); a style query only styles descendants of the element the property is set on, never that element itself.
Use container-type: inline-size for width-based @container queries.
There is no container-type for style queries; detect at-rule syntax support some other way than @supports at-rule().
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: support for comma-separated conditions is detected by comparing rendered/CSSOM state with the inputs, not with @supports.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native buttons with programmatic state; announce dynamic state changes non-visually; do not add aria-pressed to a button whose label changes to describe its state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: aria-pressed on fixed-label toggles, polite role=status summaries.

guidanceConsulted.query: read computed style to reflect CSS state in JavaScript
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Container queries evaluate the container's content box; let CSS own the layout state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: readouts read getComputedStyle on the elements the rules style and measure the content box.
